Body.Content:
Additional libraries for working with Azure services are now generally available:

  • App Configuration (Java only) 
  • Event Hubs 
  • KeyVault Certificates, Keys, and Secrets v4.0 
  • Storage Blobs, File Shares, and Queues 
  • Storage Data Lake (new generally available release) 

These are ready to use in your production applications. Read details of all released libraries on the  Azure SDK releases page. 

In addition, the Azure SDK is previewing additional libraries. Read the Azure SDK blog post for March 17, which enumerates the libraries and goes into more details on the Azure Cognitive Search library.  

Give feedback on these libraries—what you like and what you’d like to see changed—in GitHub issues. 

  • .NET 
  • Java 
  • JavaScript / TypeScript 
  • Python 

Keep up to date with all the news about the Azure developer experience programs and let us know how we’re doing by following #@azuresdk on Twitter.

Learn more
